verdict.rationale: Bruno's evidence pack documents its core file-based collection model — collections stored directly as folders on the filesystem, support for opening multiple collections from a monorepo, and the ability to rerun requests anytime via GUI or the official CLI (individual requests or entire collections). Community testimonials independently corroborate switching from Postman/Insomnia specifically because collections persist as plain files that can be reopened and rerun. missing for 10: explicit documentation calling out nested 'folders' within collections (only 'collections' and 'monorepo' are named), and independent hands-on verification of folder-level reruns beyond CLI/collection-level.
